mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alteration (type, title, domain, hostname, ip, date, user, alt_group, content, url, status, creation_date) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{domain}, #{hostname}, #{ip}, #{date}, #{user}, #{altGroup}, #{content}, #{url}, #{status}, #{creationDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE alteration SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, domain = #{domain}, hostname = #{hostname}, ip = #{ip}, date = #{date}, user = #{user}, alt_group = #{altGroup}, content = #{content}, url = #{url}, status = #{status}, creation_date = #{creationDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, domain, hostname, ip, date, user, alt_group, content, url, status, creation_date FROM alteration WHERE date >= #{record.startTime} AND date <= #{record.endTime} AND type = #{record.type} ORDER BY date desc
